title: Alibaba ActionTrail Baseline Ingestion

controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `alibaba:actiontrail` traffic without `*` markers. Confirm the search returns zero rows and alert does not fire.

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with permission to search `index=alibaba`.
• Install and configure: Splunk Add-on for Alibaba Cloud (Splunkbase 4800).
• Ensure `alibaba:actiontrail` events are flowing (prerequisite UC: none when applicable).
• Map `alibaba` and field extractions per `docs/guides/aws.md`, `docs/guides/azure.md`, or `docs/guides/gcp.md` as appropriate.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Enable alibaba:actiontrail ingestion via the appropriate Splunk TA into index=alibaba.
Expected sourcetype: `alibaba:actiontrail`. Validate with:
```spl
index=alibaba sourcetype="alibaba:actiontrail" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=alibaba sourcetype="alibaba:actiontrail"
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress errorCode
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
The search scopes `alibaba:actiontrail` in `index=alibaba` and applies `*` to surface `Alibaba ActionTrail Baseline Ingestion`. Tune time range and alert threshold to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare result counts to the vendor console (CloudTrail Event history, Azure Activity Log, GCP Logs Explorer, or service-native UI). Spot-check `_time` and actor fields. Confirm CIM acceleration only after TA field mappings are verified.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_8_1_alert` with appropriate severity. Dashboard: Ingestion health single value and lag chart..
Failure modes: (1) empty results — verify TA input and index routing; (2) duplicate events — check S3/SQS duplication; (3) missing fields — upgrade `Splunk Add-on for Alibaba Cloud (Splunkbase 4800)` and review `props.conf` aliases; (4) alert fatigue — add CMDB/allow-list exclusions documented in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch for alibaba actiontrail baseline ingestion in your cloud audit logs so the team catches important changes early instead of finding out from auditors or customers.
